tabs.html:
Ubiquiti UniFi UAP-AC-LR – 1317Mbps Dual-Band Long-Range WiFi Access Point

The Ubiquiti UniFi UAP-AC-LR is a high-performance long-range WiFi access point, designed to provide superior wireless coverage and reliability. With dual-band connectivity and speeds of up to 1317Mbps, this enterprise-grade AP is perfect for offices, businesses, cafes, hotels, and large homes. The innovative antenna design ensures extended range and strong signal penetration, making it ideal for large spaces and challenging environments.

Key Features:

  • Fast Dual-Band WiFi with 1317Mbps Speed – Up to 450Mbps (2.4GHz) + 867Mbps (5GHz)
  • Long-Range Coverage – Advanced antenna technology for extended signal reach
  • MU-MIMO & Beamforming – Optimized performance for multiple connected devices
  • Seamless UniFi Network Integration – Manage and monitor easily via the UniFi Network Application
  • Sleek, Minimalist Design – Blends effortlessly into any environment
  • PoE Support (802.3af) – Easy installation with Power over Ethernet (PoE)

Why Choose the UniFi UAP-AC-LR?

  • Superior WiFi Coverage for Large Areas

  • Ideal for Businesses, Hotels, Cafés & Homes

  • Enterprise-Grade Performance at an Affordable Price

  • Cloud-Based Management for Easy Control

Upgrade to the UniFi UAP-AC-LR and enjoy strong, stable, and long-range WiFi connectivity for all your devices.
